facts.fact: Prof. Mohammed Tawfiq Ladan, speaking at an Abuja colloquium, said Nigeria has no national policy, legislative framework or specific regulatory framework on AI development, deployment or use.

NGA.note: No government use of AI is stated.

facts.fact: Prof. Mohammed Tawfiq Ladan, former head of the Nigerian Institute of Advanced Legal Studies, said at an Abuja colloquium that Nigeria has no legislative or specific regulatory framework on AI.

NGA.note: No AI tool in a public sector system is stated.

facts.fact: Prof. Mohammed Tawfiq Ladan said NITDA developed a National AI Strategy in 2024 that is yet to be approved by the Federal Executive Council.

NGA.note: No AI model, dataset or computing built in the country is stated.
